$comment: Mirror of sprk_analysisaction.sprk_inputschema for agreement-classify (ai-advanced-capabilities-agreements-r1 task 020; FR-07 / design Lens 3d — the document classifier). Normalized OpenAI-function-parameters subset (validated by CatalogInputSchemaContractTests' directory-wide Theory + the server twin OpenAiFunctionSchemaValidator). MIRROR-FIRST from the document/session context: documentText is the current text of the document being oriented — the Assistant chat-upload path (task 021) or the Compose surface supplies it from the just-uploaded / open document, exactly as agreement-review sources documentText. The classifier is self-contained over the document alone (no RAG grounding, AllowsKnowledge=false); the sprk_agreementtype registry (candidate key set + cues) is supplied to the model as prompt data by AgreementTypeRegistryPromptAssembler, NOT as a maker-provided input field. Property-level "required": true is FORBIDDEN (use the object-level required array). Custom keyword ledger_resolution is maker metadata (OpenAI-tolerated unknown keyword). No actionId here — assigned in Dataverse at deploy time. actionCode carries NO version suffix (owner hygiene).

documentText.description: The current text of the document to classify (the just-uploaded / open document). Task 021 (interactive chat-upload) and task 023 (explicit path) supply it from the session/open document, not from Dataverse. The classifier reasons over this text plus the sprk_agreementtype registry cues injected into the prompt; it does not retrieve any other grounding. Bounded to keep the classification call economical — classification keys on the document's structure, opening, defined terms, and operative clauses.
documentText.elicitation_prompt: Which document should I classify? Upload or open the document first.
documentText.ledger_resolution: session.documentText / compose.documentText — the just-uploaded (chat) or open (Compose) document text dispatched for classification. The sprk_agreementtype candidate key set + cues are supplied by the registry assembler at dispatch time, not a maker-provided field.
